ModMetaData.name: Aragorn – Armee der Toten (v0.39)
ModMetaData.author: Aragorn Mod Project
ModMetaData.description:
DEUTSCH — Aragorn – Armee der Toten
Rette Aragorn, schmiede Andúril neu und befreie 13 Geisterkrieger in einer zusammenhängenden Questreihe. Beschwöre eine Geisterarmee mit sechs Klassen, nutze den Königlichen Befehl, mächtige Blitze, Andúrils Rundumschlag und Aragorns EMP-Sturm. Gegnerstärke, Geisterrüstung und Fähigkeiten sind einstellbar.
ENGLISH — Aragorn – Army of the Dead
Rescue Aragorn, reforge Andúril, and release 13 spectral warriors in a connected quest campaign. Summon an army across six classes and wield the King's Command, devastating lightning strikes, Andúril's sweeping attack, and Aragorn's EMP Storm. Adjust quest difficulty, spirit armor, and abilities in the mod settings.
v0.39 | RimWorld 1.6 | The Aragorn rescue is now a 77x65 fortress enclosed on every side by a 6-to-7-cell-deep WaterDeep moat, with one guarded three-wide southern bridge. The fortress has a complete outer wall, a covered inner keep and a separate central 13x9 prison (room inside room), reached by three aligned gateways. Profaned defenders occupy five posts and original Profaned lanterns/braziers furnish side guardhouses. All rescue state, Anduril progression, six spectral trials, 13 indestructible coffins, original art and Harmony fixes remain unchanged.
